title: Alpamys Makajan breaks fine-tuning limits with Soup, no data #Soup #finetuningbreakthrough #AItools
description: Alpamys Makajan developed Soup, a tool that breaks the fine-tuning barrier for large language models without expensive hardware. Soup allows fine-tuning on modest devices by using as-layer streaming, which loads and trains one model layer at a time, drastically reducing VRAM requirements from 16 GB to just 3.3 GB. This innovation enables anyone with a laptop GPU to fine-tune models like Llama efficiently, simplifying workflows with a single YAML config and command. Soup's approach eliminates the need for costly cloud infrastructure and complex setup, making AI development more accessible and affordable. Fully open-source and proven by real-world performance, Soup represents a significant step toward democratizing AI technology beyond large companies and data centers. #AlpamysMakajan #SoupTrain #LAModelFineTuning #LowVRAMAI #OpenSourceAI #DemocratizedAI #LlamaModel #AIInnovation #MachineLearningTools #AICommunity #KazakhstanTech #EdgeAI #AIhardware #LoRaAdapters #ModelOptimization
